Subject: Follow-up + MAP draft from today's discovery call

Hi Jared / Priya —

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Per our conversation, I've attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the milestones, owners, and target close date we discussed. High-level summary: 

- Target go-live: 2026-05-15 (tentative)
- Key milestones: POC kickoff, integration sprint, security review, procurement/signature
- Owner assignments: ACME (Priya/Jared) for procurement & infra, Redwood (Marissa/Camila) for technical onboarding and runbook

Please review the attached acme_map_v1.xlsx and let us know any edits to milestones or responsibilities. Suggested next steps:

1) Your feedback on the MAP by EOD Friday 3/27
2) Confirm procurement timeline (Procurement contact + expected PO date)
3) Tech kickoff: propose week of 4/6 for POC kickoff call

I copied Camila (your AE) and Rishi (solutions/CS lead) so we can align on runbook and success criteria.

Attached: acme_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), redwood-sla-summary.pdf

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and clear MAP. A few quick notes after syncing with Priya and procurement:

- Procurement: we'll target internal approvals by 4/15; PO issuance by 4/22
- Security/compliance: our security team needs the SOC2 evidence and an architecture diagram for the private deployment option. Can Redwood share SOC2 + network diagram?
- POC kickoff: week of 4/6 works for our engineering lead (Samir) but we may need to shorten scope to the core integration first (tokenization + embeddings).

I've added inline comments to the MAP (see acme_map_v1.xlsx) for updated dates and a proposed reduced-scope POC. Will Priya (cc) take point on procurement timelines.

Jared

Subject: Re: Follow-up + MAP draft from today's discovery call — updates incorporated

Thanks Jared — appreciate the quick sync.

Action taken:
- I incorporated Jared's reduced-scope POC into acme_map_v1.xlsx (tab "POC-scope") and shifted internal milestone dates.
- Attached a one-page SOC2 summary and the high-level network diagram we typically share for private deployments. Vivek (cc) can own any legal/contract Qs.

New proposed timeline (updated in MAP):
- POC kickoff: 2026-04-06
- POC complete: 2026-04-20
- Security review complete: 2026-04-27
- Procurement & signature: 2026-04-22 (PO) / signature by 2026-04-28
- Target go-live: 2026-05-15

Priya / Procurement — can you confirm the 4/22 PO target and whether you need a SOW or quotes attached? If a quote is required I can generate a formal quote for your procurement system by Monday 3/30.

Next: Camila will schedule the POC kickoff for 4/6 and include technical runbook steps.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Priya —

Per Marissa's note, I've attached the formal quote and a draft SOW (attached as PDF). Quick answers:

- Billing: we typically invoice the commitment monthly. For the POC there is a short trial credit; after go-live costs depend on usage, but for planning we recommend a budgeting range of $6k–$12k/month for the projected volume in the MAP. We'll call out the billing structure in the SOW.
- I've scheduled the POC kickoff for 2026-04-06 at 10:00 AM PT. Calendar invite to follow.

Attachments: acme_quote_2026-03-30.pdf, acme_sow_draft.pdf

Team —

Quick update from Acme: procurement will issue the PO on 2026-04-22 as planned. Procurement has also reviewed the SOW and quote and only requested one minor redline on payment terms; Vivek, if you can confirm Redwood is OK with Net-45 on the SOW we'll be ready to sign.

On the technical side, Samir confirmed POC kickoff today went well and the reduced-scope integration passed initial smoke tests. Rishi / Marissa — can you confirm the success criteria in the MAP (section 3) are now met so we can mark the MAP as final and proceed to signature?

If so, Priya — we'll coordinate signature readiness after the PO. Targeting go-live 2026-05-15.

Jared
